summary_en: Pasritamig (JNJ-78278343) is being tested with JNJ-86974680 in men with advanced prostate cancer that has spread and no longer responds to castration (metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer). Pasritamig is given intravenously and JNJ-86974680 is given orally; how often and for how long are not stated. The study aims to find the recommended phase 2 combination dose in Part 1 and to measure safety and tolerability in Part 2; it is a Phase 1b study.
summary_es: Pasritamig (JNJ-78278343) se está probando junto con JNJ-86974680 en hombres con cáncer de próstata avanzado que se ha diseminado y ya no responde a la castración (cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración). Pasritamig se administra por vía intravenosa y JNJ-86974680 por vía oral; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El estudio busca identificar la dosis combinada recomendada para fase 2 en la Parte 1 y medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad en la Parte 2; es un estudio de fase 1b.
who_for: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that has spread to bone, lymph nodes, or both.
Prior orchiectomy, or ongoing GnRH analog hormone therapy throughout treatment.
PSA of 2 ng/mL or higher at screening.
Measurable or evaluable disease and ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
not_for: Primary small cell, carcinoid, or pure neuroendocrine carcinoma of the prostate.
Side effects from prior cancer therapy not recovered to grade 1 or lower, or baseline.
Known allergy or intolerance to components of either study drug.
Active infection needing systemic antibiotics within 7 days before first dose, or leptomeningeal disease or untreated brain metastases.
Serious medical conditions or other issues that would impair treatment, consent, or study assessments, in the investigator's opinion.
